title: Changing Filmmaker's Vision: The Seer to Look and See
reason: The video discusses the process of making a documentary about Wendell Berry and his works, including title changes, filming techniques, and the themes of sustainable agriculture and community.

tasks.task: Explain the changes in the film's title and the reasoning behind them.

subtasks.text: Discuss how "The Seer" originally served as a title reflecting Wendell Berry's perspective on the future.
Explain why the filmmakers decided to change the title to "Look and See" focusing on Wendell's place and community.

tasks.task: Describe the opening sequence and its purpose in the documentary.

subtasks.text: Mention the use of a poem to transition viewers into Wendell's world.
Discuss the effort to bridge the rural and urban divide by highlighting Wendell's message to a broader audience.

tasks.task: Highlight theoretical and practical aspects of tobacco farming.

subtasks.text: Describe the characteristics of tobacco farming in rural Kentucky before large-scale mechanization.
Explain how tobacco co-ops contributed to sustainable agriculture in the past.
Provide an example of how tobacco farmers adapted during large-scale industry changes.
